title: Work-tape validation action
statement: For an input word $x$, a register index $r$ among $m$ registers, states $vWF,vWT,rw_1$, and a remembered bit that may be absent, the action on an observed symbol $a$ is as follows. If $a$ is a bit $b$, it is $xAct(r,1,0,vWT)$ when $b=1$ and $xAct(r,1,0,vWF)$ when $b=0$. If $a$ is absent, it is the rejection action when the remembered bit is $0$, and otherwise it is $xAct(r,0,0,rw_1)$.
hypotheses_covered: A register index $r$ among those $m$ registers
A remembered bit that may be absent
An observed symbol that may be absent
